🤭How to make money online selling products on Etsy you didn't make yourself using the done for you designs & print on demand method!  👇🏼Read for a step by step!  🙌🏼 How Print On Demand Works:  1. Do Some Quick Product Research - Look for popular items people are buying, like wall art, t-shirts, sweatshirts, phone cases, candles, mugs, or tote bags.   - Use tools like erank, Google Trends or browse online shops to see what's trending. I also look for inspo on Pinterest all the time! I like to use Everbee to see how much money a product is making on Etsy.  2. Create Your Design  - Get done for you designs on ctrl-alt-design.com  - Or create your own. Make your design fun, eye-catching, or niche-specific. Keep it simple and high-quality!   3. Sign Up on Printify  - Create a free account & make sure you connect your account to a store. Examples being Etsy or Shopify. You are walked through how to do this when you sign up, don’t worry it’s easy and fast.  4. Choose a Product on Printify   - Browse the product catalog for posters, t-shirts, hoodies, candles, hats, mugs, phone cases & etc.   - Select the product you want to sell.   5. Upload Your Design   - Click on the product to customize it.   - Upload your design.   - Position and resize it to fit the product nicely.   6. Fill Out Listing Details  - Write a catchy product title and description with keywords.   - Set your price (consider costs and your profit margin).   7. Publish Your Product  - Remember to connect your online store (Shopify, Etsy, etc.) with Printful . This makes it so whenever you make a sale, Printify knows instantly so it can print the design on the product for you and send it to the customer for you!  - Publish your product so it’s live and ready for customers.   8. Market Your Product - Share your product on social media, use Pinterest, create ads, or tell friends. Make videos of your product or make Pinterest pins.  - Focus on your target audience to attract more buyers. Not a must but it can help!  #howtomakemoneyonline #sidehustle #onlinesidehustle #printondemand #digitalproducts

Started the Etsy shop a month ago, got my first order shortly after... and yeah, I was buzzing 😍 It's still surreal that things I make find a place in your beautiful homes - thank you so much for that 🫶🏻 Very early in this journey, but every little thing counts. All the packaging here is recycled or reused: the styrofoam mesh came with a box of mangoes I bought 🥭, the corn peanuts and box are from deliveries I received, and even the plastic tape was salvaged from a friend who was moving and about to throw it away. I'll be switching to paper-based tape soon... just couldn't get it on short notice! Small steps, but intentional ones 🌿 #EtsyUK #HandmadeCeramics #FirstEtsySale #iknewitiknewyou  #catlover

Etsy Trenspotting EXPLAINED 💖 If you keep hearing Etsy sellers tell you that you need to be trendspotting, but no one actually ever explained how or where to go, I got you!! These are my favorite ways to start looking for and noticing trends that are currently happening. Pinterest is a great tool to organize all of your inspiration, especially because you can create an entire Pinterest board for each niche you want to sell in! Then when you actually go to make your Etsy designs, you can have that open too and you can look at things like design style, color combinations, fonts, etc. Really what you are doing is creating a habit of NOTICING what is trending so you can make sure your Etsy products are following what is popular right now 💖 Was there anywhere I missed that you like to find design trends for Etsy?? Let me know! 🙌 #etsytrends #etsysellertips #etsyseller #pinteresttrend #etsytiktok find trends on Pinterest. Etsy design trends. Etsy trendspotting. How to find Etsy trends 2026. If you want to make consistent sales on Etsy you have to understand the shopper’s buyer behaviour. What triggered them to start shopping? What products are they wanting, needing, desiring? What influences their purchasing decisions? You HAVE TO be able to answer these questions with each product you sell. #etsybeginner #creativeentrepreneurs #etsyprintondemand #etsyseller #etsyshopowner
